title: Speaker Text Formatting
body:
This page is for Speaker Text Formatting. For Signs, go to Sign Text Formatting.

About

Rich text tags are similar to XML/HTML tags where you must include both an opening and closing tag around the text. These allow you to change the font style, and have unique and interesting Speaker text!

Tags List[1]

Bold: <b>Lorem Ipsum</b> | Makes text bold.

Italics: <i>Lorem Ipsum</i> | Makes text italic.

Underline: <u>Lorem Ipsum</u> | Adds an underline to text.

Strikethrough: <s>Lorem Ipsum</s> | Strikes out text.

Smallcaps: <sc>Lorem Ipsum</sc> | Turns text into Sᴍᴀʟʟᴄᴀᴘs.

You can nest multiple tags within each other, as long as the closing tags are in the reverse order. For example, <b><i><u><sc>This text is bold, italic, underlined, and in small caps!</sc></u></i></b> would create "This text is bold, italic, underlined, and in small caps!" in bold, italic, underlined, and in smallcaps.

Keywords

Speakers have two unique "tags", referred to ingame as Keywords. These work using signal values.

Number: {num} | Chats the power value it receives. For example, pressing a Button will make it say "10", or connecting it to a Number Interface with an input of 123 will make it say "123".

Name: {display_name} | Chats the display name of the UserID it receives. For example, connecting it to a number interface with an input of 155551426 will make it say "Beta", the display name of Beta_Protogen (UserID 155551426).

These can be inserted between text, and can even be formatted with the above Tags. For example, connecting a speaker to the top wire slot of a Donator and setting the speaker's text to "<b>Thank you for your donation, <i>{display_name}</i>!</b> Fun fact: Your UserID is <u>{num}</u>!" will output the first whole sentence in bold, display name in italics, and UserID underlined.

Escape Forms[1]

If you want to render certain characters like < or > and exempt them from consideration as part of rich text tags, you can write them in their escape form. Just write the text that's under "Escape" and it should convert it to the Character version on signs in the game.

Table of escape forms, their usages, and outcomes.
Character Escape Example Result
< < x < y x < y
> > x > y y > x
" " "x" "x"
' ' 'xyz' 'xyz'
& & yes & no yes & no

Trivia

  • Rich text tags like Color (<color #></color>) and Font (<font Arial></font>) have been tested and unfortunately do not work.
    • These tags will break speakers and show a mess of code instead of outputting the desired result.
  • If a rich text tag doesn't work in a speaker, it will disappear from the text box entirely when confirmed.
